newsitem.title: USA: ServiceMaster completes Barefoot tender offer.
newsitem.headline: ServiceMaster completes Barefoot tender offer.

text.p: ServiceMaster LP said Monday it successfully completed its tender offer for the stock of Barefoot Inc., another major lawn care company, and will hold about 99 percent of the Barefoot outstanding shares.

The tender offer expired at midnight Friday, the company said. About 5 million Barefoot shares were tendered for cash and 9.1 million Barefoot shares were tendered for 5.7 million ServiceMaster shares.
ServiceMaster, a network of service companies, said it will proceed with a merger in which the remaining Barefoot shares will be converted to cash in the amount of $16 a share.
ServiceMaster had offered $16 or 0.62971 ServiceMaster shares for each Barefoot share tendered. Barefoot is a lawn care company with annual revenues of more than $125 million.

"We are pleased with the overwhelmingly positive response to our tender offer and excited about the opportunities created by combining Barefoot with our TruGreen-Chemlawn business," Carlos Cantu, president of Downers Grove, Ill.-based ServiceMaster said in a statement.
ServiceMaster owns TruGreen-ChemLawn, the nation's largest lawn care company, with annual revenues of over $630 million.
Barefoot ranks second in the industry, with more than 500,000 customers in 103 metropolitan markets and annual customer level revenues in excess of $125 million.
ServiceMaster's stock edged down 12.5 cents to $25.625 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
